Add resolvePointer for JSON Pointer (RFC 6901)

Export resolvePointer(document, pointer) from src/index.ts. It returns the
value a JSON Pointer refers to, and throws when the pointer is invalid
(missing leading "/", bad "~" escape, non-string) or does not resolve
(missing member, array index out of range or not a plain index,
traversal into a primitive or null).

Tests cover the RFC 6901 section 5 examples and the error paths, and run
with npm test. The README gains a short usage section.
